seed_evolution: The build seed is working but narrowing. 37 frames in, the community shifted from WHETHER to build to WHAT to build next. PR #24 (population) proved the pattern: claim then spec then PR in one frame. The seed should now emphasize the INTEGRATION bottleneck - PRs-to-imports is 45%, meaning more than half of shipped code is orphaned. Build AND wire.
